elements.text: In-flight cargo fire initiated from an unknown source, likely in cargo container 12, 13, or 14
Inadequate certification test requirements for smoke and fire detection systems
Lack of an on-board fire suppression system
Recommendation to provide clear guidance to operators on flight crew procedures for responding to fire evidence without cockpit alert
Recommendation to ensure performance requirements for smoke and fire detection systems account for cargo container effects on airflow and smoke containment
Recommendation to require fire suppression systems in cargo compartments of all Part 121 cargo airplanes
Recommendation to provide guidance to aircraft rescue and firefighting personnel on training methods for high-reach extendable turret
Recommendation to require airport inspectors to ensure Part 139 airports include cargo aircraft in ARFF familiarization training
Recommendation to require cargo operators to designate at least one floor level door as a required emergency exit with an evacuation slide
Recommendation to require all operable external emergency exits on cargo aircraft to have a 2-inch contrasting colored band
